dayFirst.description: Reads dates such as "05/03/2024", where either part could be the month, day first (5 March). Without it, a clear date in the column decides (25/03/2024), otherwise month first. true also reads "05.03.24" as day.month.year

sort.description: Row order: "none" keeps the data order, "start" puts the earliest start first, "duration" the longest total first

referenceLines.description: Vertical lines on the time axis [{ x, label }]. x is a number or a date, like the data. Lines outside the axis range are not drawn

now.description: Time of a "Now" line, in the same form as the data. Items without an end run up to it. The chart never reads the clock, so server and browser draw the same

brush.description: Drag across the time axis to zoom in: "zoom" or true (keyboard: Shift+arrows, Enter). Escape or "Show all" zooms out

hidden.description: Series to hide. Colors stay as if every series were shown. With card.legend "toggle", viewers can show them again

oneOf.title: Tree
oneOf.description: The parent and child links of a hierarchy, drawn as dots joined by curves. Use when: The structure itself is the point: an org chart, a folder or dependency tree, what an outage reaches, a decision tree. Avoid when: Each part's share of the total matters more than the links (treemap or sunburst), or the leaves are thousands of items to compare by size

value.description: Value field. Sizes the dots; values add up from the leaves (number)

group.description: Parent group field (flat rows, as in the treemap) (string)

id.description: Row id for id/parent rows. Defaults to the label (string)

parent.description: Parent id field. Each row is one node, and rows with an empty parent hang under the root (string)

layout.description: "horizontal" puts the root on the left and the leaves on the right, with level labels that read at any width. "radial" puts the root in the center and fits more leaves into a square

sort.description: Sort siblings largest first by value. Off keeps the data order

rootLabel.description: Name of the root that is added when the data has several top-level nodes

collapsed.description: Branches that start folded, by name or by path such as "Orders/Checkout". Server rendering folds them too

oneOf.title: Symbol map
oneOf.description: One circle per place on a pale map, its area proportional to the value. Use when: Amounts that sit at a point, such as users per city, revenue per store or traffic per data centre, where absolute sizes should compare directly. Avoid when: The value is a rate across a whole region (use choropleth), or the places are so many and so close that circles cover each other (aggregate first)

region.description: Region of options.map, for rows without lon and lat (string)

map.description: Base map. "auto" picks the registered map that takes the most places (coordinates inside it or region names on it), and the narrower map on a tie, so US cities land on "us-states". legend.description: "auto" builds the legend from the data. "toggle" also lets viewers click it to show and hide series in the browser (line, area, bar, scatter, and timeline groups). Images and static HTML draw it like "auto"
